verdict.rationale: Wave documents its own recurring automations: recurring invoices with automatic billing, and scheduled overdue reminders that fire 3, 7 and 14 days after the due date. These are fixed-purpose schedules for invoicing only, not a general way to schedule arbitrary jobs or workflows. Wave's public pages document no API, CLI or webhook surface for programmatic or AI-driven scheduling. Missing for 10: user-definable recurring jobs or workflows beyond invoices and reminders, any programmatic or API-based scheduling, custom cron-style schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Set up recurring invoices and automatic credit card payments for your repeat customers and stop chasing payments.
Send recurring invoices with total flexibility. Switch between automatic and manual billing whenever you want.
Schedule reminders to automatically deploy 3, 7, and 14 days after sent invoices are due
